digest.component_or_area: Quality audit remediation (CI, documentation, code structure)
propositions: Python 3.11 xdist worker teardown race under contention in test_opcert_service_app causes benign exit-0 failure noise but is not an app-code bug
Assignee/user-facing documentation example teaches a Jira-unresolvable identity inconsistent with docs/config.md
Near-cap modules (structured_run.py, compact.py, event_append.py) mix responsibilities/layers and contain duplicated infrastructure, preventing regression and requiring structural decomposition

Graph loader/traversal subsystem has duplicated traversal logic across _find_direct_blockers, _get_all_blocked_by, check_cycle_at_level, detect_newly_unblocked that drives cyclomatic complexity above target
attest package has untyped definitions failing mypy --disallow-untyped-defs enforcement
Module splits and graph centralization must preserve public import paths and function semantics without editing contended files in scope of other in-progress work
